title: Single-cell DNA (Tapestri) processed data (h5 file)
platform: Mission Bio Tapestri single-cell DNA sequencing platform
pipeline: Mission Bio 'mosaic' downstream analysis pipeline (recommended by depositor for these H5 files)
anatomic_location_breakdown: 3 H5 files, filenames indicate dural/falcine origin ('241127_Falx.dna.h5', '230802_Dura.dna.h5', '190426_Dura.dna.h5'); description states nuclei were isolated from the meningeal dura of meningioma patients. Exact per-patient anatomic detail beyond these filename labels is not reported.
processed_data_format: Mission Bio Tapestri per-cell H5 files (single-nucleus-level read profiles, genotypes, and variant profiles)
needs_manual_review_reason: UPDATE 2026-07-11 (centralized integration pass): a dedicated 'scdna_seq' modality value was added to docs/controlled_vocabulary.md for single-cell/single-nucleus targeted DNA sequencing (Mission Bio Tapestri and similar droplet-based targeted DNA panels at single-cell resolution), and this record now uses it in place of the closest-fit 'targeted_panel_seq' value used at initial extraction. tags.single_cell_resolved is set to true, now a direct and literal match for the new modality value rather than a judgment call. No linked publication could be found via PubMed author-name or keyword search (Chung Young-soo + meningioma/Tapestri/dura/single-nucleus all returned zero hits) as of live verification 2026-07-11; this appears to be a data-only deposit with no accompanying paper. patient_count left 'Not reported' because it is unclear whether the 3 H5 files (dated 190426, 230802, 241127, i.e. spanning ~2019-2024) represent 3 distinct patients or repeat/re-processed runs on fewer patients; sample_count=3 reflects the 3 distinct H5 files actually deposited. institution inferred from depositor's public ORCID employment record (Yonsei University College of Medicine, Dept. of Biomedical Systems Informatics, listed through 2024-08); current affiliation at time of 2026-05-23 upload not independently confirmed. tags.large_cohort left false pending centralized recomputation across the whole inventory per project instructions (not specific to this record's small n). DEEP-AUDIT (2026-07-14, no field changes): re-fetched the live Figshare API (api.figshare.com/v2/articles/32386740), which confirms author 'Young-soo Chung (ORCID: 0000-0001-8012-2902)' as the sole listed creator, license CC BY 4.0, and no linked publication/DOI beyond the dataset's own -- corresponding_author, license, and 'no publication' status all reconfirmed unchanged. Re-searched for a Young-soo Chung + Tapestri/meningioma/dura publication (web search); still zero matches, consistent with a data-only deposit. sample_count=3 and the three filename-derived anatomic labels reconfirmed against the live record.

gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: All 3 samples merged (Falx tumor + 2 Dura), variant genotype not gene expression
gene_expression_viewer.value_label: genotype: 0=WT/hom-ref, 1=het, 2=hom-alt (missing calls excluded from the color scale)
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: Mission Bio Tapestri .h5 files (Falx: 76 cells, Dura_230802: 274 cells, Dura_190426: 36 cells; all cells in each file's own dna_variants assay had a valid clone/UMAP position). Used the Tapestri pipeline's OWN precomputed UMAP coordinates and clone-cluster assignments (all_barcodes/dna_read_counts/ra) rather than recomputing an embedding -- appropriate here since Tapestri's own pipeline already clusters cells on read-count profiles across the full amplicon panel, which this project's generic scRNA pipeline has no equivalent for. Variant panel: of 25,643 variants called in all 3 samples, the 100 with the highest non-reference genotype fraction (i.e. the most 'interesting'/variable calls) were kept, analogous to picking highly-variable genes for an expression panel.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: Unlike the scRNA-seq records, this is genuinely different DATA (per-cell DNA variant genotype from targeted amplicon sequencing, not gene expression), so it deliberately reuses the same UMAP/cluster/"color by X" viewer machinery with different labels (see feature_noun/value_label) rather than inventing a separate component. Cluster labels are Mission Bio's own clone calls, not independently derived or verified in this pass.
